settings.title: Build your website, publish content, and support users from one place
settings.description: FrontLit is the connected front office for your product: a visual site builder, one content system for articles, docs, and changelog, a shared inbox with AI answers, and email — API first and ready to grow with you.
One dashboard for the public site your customers see and the support tools that keep them.

items.question: What can I build with FrontLit?
items.answer: A marketing website, articles, documentation, product updates, a help desk, and email — all from one connected dashboard.

items.question: Do I need to know how to code?
items.answer: No. Every page is assembled from ready-made blocks, and you can customize copy, media, and layout without touching code.

items.question: Can I use my own domain?
items.answer: Yes. Every FrontLit site can be connected to a custom domain from website settings.

items.question: How do customers reach support?
items.answer: The /help page ships with a support form. Tickets land in your shared inbox, and you can turn on an AI agent that answers from your published docs.

items.question: Is there a free plan?
items.answer: Yes. Start for free and upgrade as your audience grows.
